title: LifeOS auth gate — console/operator login; join public
problem: Open join was previously redirected to login, blocking new-user onboarding.
current: Join (/lifeos/join GET+POST) is public for new users.
Login (/lifeos/login) is separate for existing ecomae accounts.
Companion/results use clientId + joinToken (not login wall).
Console / directory / clients board still require login via LifeOsPersonalAuthGateMiddleware.
